title: End-to-end skeleton: sutra_explore with grep + basic ranking
description:
## Parent

sutra/169 — PRD: sutra_explore

## What to build

Wire up `sutra_explore(query, workspace, budget)` end-to-end as a new MCP tool. Register the handler in `src/mcp.rs` and `src/tools/mod.rs`. Create `src/tools/explore.rs` with the full pipeline skeleton:

1. Basic pattern expansion: literal match + snake_case split (e.g. "import parsing" → `import_pars`, `import.*pars`)
2. Grep against the symbol index via the existing sutra_grep path
3. Match-density-only ranking (count of expanded patterns that hit each symbol)
4. Assembly: flat item list with symbol, file, kind, lines, estimated_tokens (line_count × ~4), and literal `sutra_read(symbol='...')` fetch string
5. Trivial strategy: `read_all` if ≤3 hits, `narrow_query` if 10+ hits, `read_top_n` otherwise

Response shape must match the PRD spec (items array, strategy object with action/n/rationale, summary object). Zero grep hits return empty items with `narrow_query` action.

Integration test: call the tool with a known topic, verify response structure and that items have valid fetch strings.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `sutra_explore` registered as MCP tool, callable with query/workspace/budget args
- [ ] Budget parameter defaults to 10, controls max items returned
- [ ] Pattern expansion produces at least literal + snake_case split variants
- [ ] Items include symbol, file, kind, lines, estimated_tokens, fetch fields
- [ ] Strategy hint present with action enum and rationale string
- [ ] Zero-hit case returns empty items with narrow_query strategy
- [ ] Integration test passes

## Blocked by

None — can start immediately.
